evidence.quote: Ecwid API is a RESTful API with oAuth2 authentication.
Ecwid supports oAuth2 protocol to provide applications with an easy way to authenticate and access store data on behalf of the user with access tokens.
If you customize your own store, however, you can skip OAuth and easily get an access token for your store.
Public token allows only public data to be received and is safe to use in public code
Both types of access tokens do not expire, so you can use them as long as the application is installed in a merchant's store.

result.notes: Ecwid REST API (docs.ecwid.com / api-docs.ecwid.com redirects there). Two credential paths: (1) OAuth2 authorization-code flow for public apps distributed to merchants, requiring the merchant to install the app and grant scopes — no partner gate or app-store review documented for using the API itself; (2) for a developer's own store, you can skip OAuth entirely and copy a static secret/public access token directly from the app dashboard (my.ecwid.com/#develop-apps) after free signup — functions like a personal API key. This makes it self-serve free. api_breadth is an estimate (products, orders, customers, categories, discounts, shipping/tax, webhooks, storefront) — did not enumerate the full endpoint list within budget, so treat as medium with moderate confidence. MCP is community-only (io.usefulapi/ecwid), not vendor-published.
result.one_liner: Ecwid is a hosted ecommerce platform (part of Lightspeed) offering a REST API to manage products, orders, customers, and storefront data.
